harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc service account and inventory-readers group, then set ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750 on directories and 640 on files, so the owner and group members can read while others are denied at both file and directory-traversal level. All original file contents were preserved (checksums verified unchanged before and after). Also completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a boot_id baseline, issued a native systemctl reboot, confirmed the connection dropped and recovered, verified the boot_id changed, and re-verified data integrity and permissions post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory: data was owned by root, world-readable (644/755), and neither inventorysvc user nor inventory-readers group existed
Captured sha256 checksums and contents of config.json and records.csv as a preservation baseline
Created group inventory-readers (gid 1000) and system user inventorysvc (uid/gid 996, nologin shell, no home dir)
Ran chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory; chmod 750 on all directories and 640 on all files
Verified checksums unchanged after the permission repair (data preserved)

Created temporary test users (reader_test in inventory-readers group, other_test unrelated) and used sudo -u to confirm owner and group member can read the files while the unrelated user is denied at both file and directory level; then removed the temporary test users
Captured node1 boot_id and uptime baseline plus a healthy-state snapshot of /srv/inventory (ownership, perms, checksums)
Issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot on node1 so the exec acknowledgement returned before the connection dropped
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again, confirming boot_id changed from 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 to b5c8bf72-0231-49a8-a52c-5281fa3986fc
Post-restart, re-verified uptime reflects the new boot, checksums still match baseline, ownership/permissions on /srv/inventory persisted, and inventorysvc/inventory-readers still exist

evidence.requirement: Baseline: original ownership/permissions and data content before repair
evidence.summary: Showed /srv/inventory owned by root:root with default 644/755 perms, no inventorysvc/inventory-readers, and captured checksums/content of config.json and records.csv

evidence.requirement: inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group created
evidence.summary: groupadd/useradd created inventory-readers (gid 1000) and inventorysvc (uid 996); confirmed via id and getent group

evidence.requirement: Ownership set to inventorysvc:inventory-readers with restrictive permissions
evidence.summary: chown -R and chmod 750/640 applied; ls -laR shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership and drwxr-x---/-rw-r----- perms on all files and directories

evidence.requirement: Existing data content preserved through the repair
evidence.summary: sha256sum of config.json and records.csv identical before and after the chown/chmod operations

evidence.requirement: Data readable by inventory-readers group and inaccessible to other users
evidence.summary: sudo -u tests: inventorysvc (owner) and reader_test (group member) could read config.json; other_test (unrelated) got Permission denied on both file read and directory listing. Temporary test users then removed

evidence.requirement: Final permission/ownership state on node1
evidence.summary: Final ls -laR confirms inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 750 dirs / 640 files across /srv/inventory

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: healthy baseline (boot identity + service/data health) before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358, uptime, checksums, and full permission listing of /srv/inventory prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded systemctl reboot command returned 'reboot-scheduled' immediately, before the node disconnected

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: proof of actual disconnect/reboot in progress
evidence.summary: Subsequent exec calls failed with connection timed out / connection reset by peer, showing node1 was down mid-reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: changed boot identity proving restart occurred
evidence.summary: Node became reachable again with boot_id b5c8bf72-0231-49a8-a52c-5281fa3986fc, differing from the pre-restart value of 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart: post-restart recovery of required services/data
evidence.summary: Post-restart uptime shows new boot time (08:21:30), checksums of config.json/records.csv unchanged from baseline, and ownership/permissions on /srv/inventory (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 750/640) persisted correctly; inventorysvc user and inventory-readers group still present
